scripts.features:
Auto Farm (1v1): Automatically joins matches, targets enemies, equips your knife, and attacks for continuous farming.

Auto Server Hop: Automatically joins a new server if no match is found after being idle for several minutes.

Auto Join Pads: Automatically teleports to matchmaking pads and joins available games.

Auto Equip Knife: Automatically equips your knife whenever combat begins.

Orbit Target: Circles around your target while attacking to make you harder to hit.

Enable Hitbox Expander: Enlarges enemy hitboxes, making opponents much easier to hit.

Hitbox Size: Adjust the size of expanded hitboxes with a customizable slider.

Hitbox Transparency: Customize the visibility of expanded hitboxes.

Team Check (Hitbox): Prevents hitbox expansion from affecting teammates.

Box ESP: Displays boxes around players, allowing you to track them through walls.

Look Tracers: Shows the direction each player is facing.

Team Check (ESP): Hides teammates from ESP to reduce visual clutter.

Dynamic ESP Colors: Automatically colors ESP based on each player's team.

Field of View: Adjust your camera's FOV for a wider or narrower view.
